newsitem.title: PERU: Lima stocks end mixed, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Lima stocks end mixed, seen stable.

text.p: Shares on the Lima Stock Exchange closed mixed Tuesday on a natural levelling of prices, which were expected to remain broadly stable Wednesday, brokers said.
Analysts said the market was still levelling off after a recent series of rises, which had brought some corrections.
"It is a normal behaviour after various sessions of rises and few corrections," said Israel Menor, of Divisas y Valores brokerage.
The General Index fell 0.10 percent to 1,524.56 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index gained a nominal 0.02 percent to 2,193.94 points.
In a total of 1,413 trades, volume was estimated at a modest 17 million soles ($6.5 million), brokers said.

Among leaders, confectionery company D'Onofrio fell 4.17 percent to 1.15 soles on 11,348 shares, while miner Atacocha lost 1.18 percent to 0.84 soles on 324,624 shares and brewery Backus y Johnston ended off 0.92 percent to 2.16 soles on 139,769 shares.
Benchmark Telefonica del Peru gained 0.18 percent to 5.62 soles on 776,676 shares.
